profile_text.body:
Seagate Technology Holdings plc is a public company headquartered in Singapore and traded under the ticker STX. Its website describes it as a leader in mass-capacity data storage, saying the company has delivered more than four billion terabytes of capacity over the past four decades. Seagate says it makes storage that scales and that its drives support innovations that depend on data.

The site frames AI as a driver of data growth and of changing storage requirements. Seagate says it is optimizing storage for AI, describing gains in capacity intended to support data center architecture and buildout, and it invites organizations to assess their readiness and develop a storage strategy built for performance, scale, and growth. The site also points to five strategic shifts it says can help close the gap between AI's data demands and infrastructure readiness.

The company's profile lists a CIK number of 0001137789 and identifies it as a for-profit public company. No products, lawsuits, or MCP servers are recorded for it.
